name: Pulse Dot
description: An animated pulsing dot that signals live presence or ongoing activity.

anatomy.description: Small solid marker colored by the semantic variant.
Expanding aria-hidden ring animated with ping; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
Accessible name describing the live state, applied as aria-label on the role="status" element.

dos: Use it for things happening right now: live presence, recording, or a streaming connection.
Always pass a label that says what is live, such as "3 editors online".
donts: Don't use it for static states; use StatusDot instead.
Don't run several pulse dots in one view; keep one live signal per region.

examples.title: Live presence
examples.description: A pulsing dot next to a label for collaborators or live streams.

examples.title: Semantic variants
examples.description: Danger, warning, and neutral pulses for recording, away, or idle states.

guidance.useWhen: Something is actively happening right now — live presence, recording, or a streaming connection.
guidance.avoidWhen: The state is static; use StatusDot instead, which has no animation.
guidance.behavior: Pulses continuously while mounted; the animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
guidance.responsive: Fixed small footprint that fits inline next to text at any width.

notes: Rendered as role="status" with an aria-label that describes the live state.
The pulsing ring is aria-hidden and uses motion-reduce to respect prefers-reduced-motion.

props.description: Accessible label describing the live state, for example "3 editors online".
props.name: label
